scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run assert:css
scripts.lint:responsive: command -v rg >/dev/null || { echo 'lint:responsive needs ripgrep on PATH; a missing rg exits 127, which `&& fail=1` skips, so the gate would report success while checking nothing'; exit 1; }; fail=0; echo 'checking for banned responsive idioms'; rg -n --glob 'apps/web/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}' -e '\[@media' -e '\bmax-\[[0-9][^]]*\]:' -e '\bmin-\[[0-9][^]]*\]:' -e '@max-\[' -e '@min-\[' -e '@\[[0-9]' -e '\b(sm|md|lg|xl|2xl):' && fail=1; rg -n --glob 'apps/web/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}' '\[&[^]]*:hover' | rg -v 'hoverable:\[&' | rg . && fail=1; exit $fail
scripts.assert:css: grep -Eq '@media[^{]*pointer[^{]*coarse' apps/web/dist/assets/*.css || { echo 'built CSS carries no (pointer: coarse) rule, so the touch work compiled to nothing'; exit 1; }; grep -Eq '@media[^{]*height[^{]*480px' apps/web/dist/assets/*.css || { echo 'built CSS carries no height < 480px rule, so the short: variant compiled to nothing'; exit 1; }; ! grep -Eq '(760|480|800)\.02' apps/web/dist/assets/*.css || { echo 'built CSS still carries a .02 container threshold'; exit 1; }
